purpose: Close the fixed historical cohort gap, not add a strategy or universe member.

prices.calendar_role: Observed fixed account calendar, not proof of absence of security-specific halts.
prices.volume_overlap_rule: List all discrepancies and verify market/session definitions; do not average them or silently choose a preferred supplier.
additional_requirements: Legitimate access and license covering local research; external reviewers need their own permitted access.
Original source capture, file SHA, supplier release identity and adjustment conventions.
Unique date/security rows; finite positive prices; OHLC bounds; valid regular-session volume and trading flags.
Issuer/security/class identity and exact listing lifecycle separately verified; symbol alone is insufficient.
Corporate-action event source and raw/adjusted lineage; zeros or blanks do not certify no actions.
Any unexplained overlap, missing row or corporate-action difference blocks consumption.

rules: Contractual entitlement and paying-agent funding do not prove broker cash availability.
Do not apply the ordinary three-session trade lock to a merger payment as a factual receipt.
Book-entry holder transmittal exemption does not prove a customer account is funded.
Separate certificate surrender, employee equity award payroll and ordinary common-stock payment rules.
No inferred cash reinvestment while spendable_at is unknown; record the unresolved receivable separately.
Unknown fees, withholding, ownership or currency must stay unknown.
Forecast, expected closing and verified completion are distinct event kinds.
Current updated Nasdaq page has no verified revision publication clock; do not backdate its final text to its original displayed date.
Raw SEC acceptance clocks are verified in UTC; the existing one-hour processing lag is an assumption, not an observed first-release clock.
Last trading day, merger occurrence, listing suspension and broker payment cannot be represented by one end date.
